sunburned: He stayed on the beach too long and got badly sunburned.
他在海滩上待得太久,被严重晒伤了。
climber: The young climber reached the top of the mountain before dark.
这位年轻的登山者在天黑前到达了山顶。
be used to: After living in the countryside, she is used to the quiet life.
在乡下住了一段时间后,她已经习惯了安静的生活。
take risks: You should think carefully before you take risks with your money.
在拿自己的钱冒险之前,你应该仔细考虑。
kg: This bag of rice weighs ten kg, so it is too heavy for me.
这袋大米重十公斤,对我来说太重了。
run out (of): We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop to buy some.
我们的牛奶用完了,所以我去商店买了一些。
cut off: The storm cut off the electricity in the whole village.
暴风雨切断了整个村庄的电力。
get out of: Please get out of the car slowly because the road is busy.
请慢慢下车,因为路上车很多。
be in control of: A good driver must be in control of the car at all times.
一个好的司机必须时刻掌控汽车。
give up: Never give up your dreams, even when things get difficult.
即使情况变得困难,也永远不要放弃你的梦想。
clean up: The students cleaned up the classroom after the party.
学生们在聚会后把教室打扫干净了。
cheer up: Cheer up! The weather will be fine again tomorrow.
振作起来!明天天气就会好起来了。
give out: The sun gives out light and heat every day.
come up with: She came up with a good idea to solve the problem.
她想出了一个解决问题的好主意。
put off: Don't put off your homework until it is too late.
不要把作业拖到太晚才做。
hand out: The teacher asked me to hand out the test papers.
老师让我把试卷分发下去。
call up: I will call you up as soon as I arrive in Beijing.
我一到北京就给你打电话。
used to: My grandfather used to tell me stories about his childhood.
我爷爷曾经给我讲他童年的故事。
care for: The nurse cares for the old people in the hospital every day.
这位护士每天在医院照料老人。
try out: I want to try out the new computer before I buy it.
我想在购买前先试用一下这台新电脑。
fix up: My father helped me fix up my old bike last weekend.
上周末我爸爸帮我修理了那辆旧自行车。
give away: The kind man decided to give away all his old clothes.
那位善良的男人决定把他所有的旧衣服都赠送出去。
take after: Everyone says the daughter takes after her mother in looks.
大家都说这个女儿长相像她妈妈。
set up: They set up a small company to sell their products online.
他们成立了一家小公司,在网上销售产品。
make a difference: Helping others can really make a difference to their lives.
帮助别人真的能改变他们的生活。
take out the rubbish: Please remember to take out the rubbish before you leave home.
离家前请记得把垃圾拿出去倒了。
all the time: My little brother watches cartoons all the time on weekends.
我弟弟周末一直看动画片。
as soon as: I will send you a message as soon as I get home.
我一到家就给你发消息。
in order to: He gets up early in order to catch the first bus.
为了赶上第一班公交车,他起得很早。
depend on: Whether we go on a picnic depends on the weather tomorrow.
我们是否去野餐取决于明天的天气。
fairness: The teacher is known among the students for her fairness.
这位老师因其公正而在学生中出名。
take care of: You should take care of yourself when your parents are away.
父母不在时,你应该照顾好自己。
What's wrong?: You look sad today. What's wrong with you?
你今天看起来很难过,你怎么了?
look through: I looked through the newspaper quickly during breakfast.
吃早餐时我快速浏览了一下报纸。
big deal: Losing one game is no big deal, so please don't cry.
输一场比赛没什么大不了的,所以别哭了。
work out: They talked for a long time and finally worked out the problem.
他们谈了很长时间,终于解决了这个问题。
get on well (with): Tom gets on well with his classmates at the new school.
汤姆在新学校和同学们相处得很好。
secondly: First, read the questions carefully; secondly, write down your answers.
首先,仔细阅读问题;其次,写下你的答案。
cut out: The doctor told him to cut out sugar to stay healthy.
医生让他停止吃糖以保持健康。
compare…with: Don't compare yourself with others too much; just do your best.
不要过多地把自己和别人比较,尽力就好。
